event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: USA 222035 is represented by Charlotte ROSE.
ISR 220477 is represented by Shai KAKON.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
USA 222035 and ISR 220477 provided video evidence.
During the hearing the protest committee clarified in accordance with RRS 63.2(c) that the hearing request was not only a protest but also a request for redress, and proceeded with it accordingly.
facts: About 30 seconds before the start of race F2 for ILCA 6 Gold fleet, USA 222035 and ISR 220477 were stationary on starboard tack to leeward of the starting line.
USA 222035 was overlapped with and to leeward of ISR 220477 at a lateral distance of 1 meter.
About 15 seconds before the starting signal, ISR 220477 bore away on a collision course with USA 222035 and luffed to head-to-wind again within 2 second.
Immediately a contact occured between ISR 220477’s left aft corner and USA 222035’s tiller.
The tiller snapped about 30 cm from the tiller extension joint.
USA 222035 retired from race F2, ISR 220477 finished the race.
conclusions: ISR 220477 to windward failed to keep clear of USA 222035 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
ISR 220477 did not avoid contact with USA 222035 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for USA 222035 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with ISR 220477 when it became clear that ISR 220477 was not keeping clear. USA 222035 did not break RRS 14(a).

USA 222035’s score in race F2 was made significantly worse through no fault of her own by physical damage because of the action of ISR 220477 that was breaking RRS 11 and 14(a) and was penalized. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(2) are met.
decision: ISR 220477 is DSQ in race F2. Redress is given to USA 222035. USA 222035 is to be scored in race F2 points equal to the average, rounded to the nearest tenth of a point (0.05 to be rounded upward), of her points races F1 and F3. No other boat’s score shall change.
